patterns.what_worked: Hiding the offhand size options was already half-done by layout-finish; mirroring its exact pattern (show effective value + locked + description + routed write) made E1 a small, low-risk widget change with no saved-key migration. For P4, recording the hide reason at the same place the poll hides the bar (rather than re-deriving visibility in diag.lua) means the report and the decision cannot drift; the power bar got the same receipt pattern (pb.resolve -> pb.last_state read by diag). Mutation proofs found two weak test texts (mutations that left the pinned phrase intact) before they could linger as false confidence.
patterns.what_was_hard: The working tree was not quiet: another lane was rewriting hunter_ui.lua mid-wave, which once showed up as 15 phantom hunter failures in tests/bars_state.lua and briefly as one extra hunter-owned frame against that file's HUNTER extra_frames pin. /tmp is also being purged by another actor, so a tree copy for mutation proofs vanished between commands (and one scripted mutation briefly landed in the real option_tables.lua before being restored and verified) - the mutation harness was rewritten to patch files in memory through io.open/loadfile substitution, touching nothing on disk.
patterns.skill_gap: Should have checked /tmp stability before designing the evidence method, and should have used an in-place-safe harness from the start instead of a copy that can disappear (and can fall through to the real tree if the cd fails).
